comparison.title: Bioidentical vs. conventional hormone therapy
comparison.lead: Bioidentical hormones are molecule for molecule identical to the hormones your body produces itself. Many conventional preparations contain synthetic hormones, whose chemical structure is slightly different from your body’s own.

values.text: Identical to your body’s own hormones
Often synthetic: similar, but slightly different
Synthetic oestrogens and progestins, sometimes estradiol
A compounding pharmacy, individually for you
Prepared to strict compounding pharmacy standards

more.text: or the Rimkus method on request
more.check_note: Rimkus name only once the practice confirms the certification is current (CLAUDE.md). Without it the cell reads “Our own protocol”.

values.text: When you prefer it, or when it suits you better

comparison.summary: Both options are valid. Which one fits you is decided together in your consultation.
comparison.check_note: Condensed by Claude on 14 Oct 2026 (user asked for a compact, label-style table) from Dr. Tuszing’s “Bioidentical vs. Conventional Hormone Therapy” doc of the same day: “Dose” and “Dosing based on” kept as two rows, “(gestagens)” and “specialised” dropped, headings shortened, title in sentence case. Practice to confirm the wording. Also ask: most licensed European HRT already uses estradiol, and micronised progesterone is licensed too, so “sometimes estradiol” may undersell conventional therapy.
